business_summary: Antofagasta plc is a UK-incorporated, LSE-listed copper mining group operating mines in Chile. Its copper output feeds the global conductor supply pool the chain's copper-conductors link tracks, though the link is scored a commodity pass-through rather than a project-specific revenue stream for the dam.
